snippet.title: Way Too Many Fish! - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4564070/Way_Too_Many_Fish/utm_analytics=YouTube

Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.

Join our Discord for more updates :)!
https://discord.gg/GNwWJNU3fE

A game by @samyam
